## Summary

Describe the change and the charger/firmware it targets.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] JSON files validate
- [ ] Existing entity unique IDs are unchanged, or migration is included
- [ ] No PIN, complete Bluetooth address, user ID or unrelated HA data is included
- [ ] Write/control changes were supervised on real hardware, if applicable
